title: A week ago I launched a free Warcraft 3 style tower defense built with Claude Code. 1000+ players on day one, 300+ changes since, and now 4v4 Ranked
author: vidiclol
selftext:
**Hey** r/aigamedev**,**

A week ago I launched Towers of Aurum, a free co-op tower defence game in the browser, built with Claude Code and Opus 5.5 as my coding partner. It's my love letter to the Warcraft 3 custom maps I grew up on, Green TD especially. 1000+ people played it on day one, which I genuinely did not expect. Thank you to everyone who jumped in, broke things and told me about it.

Here's the follow-up. Since launch I've pushed over 300 changes, and a lot of them came straight from player feedback.

The big ones:

🏰 **4v4 Ranked.** Your team of four and another team play the same night on separate maps, facing the same monsters. Kill faster and the extra creeps get sent straight to the other team. You can watch a live map of their side with each player's name over their towers. If both teams survive the final boss, it's sudden death: every wave gets tougher until someone falls. Real players only, never bots.

📖 **Story Mode, rebuilt.** One long journey across a fallen land to close its gates, and each of the four peoples does it their own way. Every page has its own hand-built map with rivers, timber bridges and broken stone. Between battles your people travel the map as a caravan: an Oni war sledge with a drum, a Ronin ox cart, a Kitsune lantern palanquin, and pandas carrying the Shrine's cuttings.

🎓 **A first run that teaches you.** Tomo, a little lantern, walks you through one short run. The game asks once whether you've played tower defence before, and if you say yes, you skip straight to the good stuff.

📱 **Proper phone play.** Drag to look around, pinch to zoom, tap twice to build, and tower ranges and auras show right on the map.

💬 **Social.** World chat for everyone, whispers, an ignore list, party chat, and a kill board so your mates can see who's actually carrying.

⚔️ **Quick Play runs.** A Quick Run when you've got ten minutes, a Full Run, and Endless with monthly leaderboards.

🎃 **Halloween event and skins.** Skins are looks only, never power. Finish a Ranked season at Gold or higher to earn the Victorious skin, a gold laurel and embers that can go on any of the 40 towers.

🪨 **New Shrine towers.** Every Shrine tower got its own top on a pale limestone base.

How it's made:

**Code:** Claude Code + Opus 5.5, every day. TypeScript, raw WebGPU with no game engine, and a game simulation that plays out exactly the same on every device. That's what makes the multiplayer possible.

**Servers:** all on Cloudflare. Every match runs on its own small server (a Durable Object), with D1 for accounts and ratings. No VMs to babysit.

**Art:** no image models at all. Every tower, creep, map and texture is drawn by code that Claude wrote, so there's no 3D pipeline and no generated images. Sound effects are made in code too.

**Music:** my own recordings.

**Agents:** for the big features I had it spin up a team of game designers to argue out the rules and the rating maths. Then three agents built it in parallel while a QA agent's only job was to break it. It found real bugs, like a server restart letting a player who'd quit get their gate back. Every one got fixed and re-checked live.

**Me:** design, taste, testing, and saying "no, that's not fun yet" a lot. Claude writes the code, but deciding whether a boss feels scary or a leak feels unfair is still the job.

Play it free in your browser. We're in beta:

👉 [**towersofaurum.com**](http://towersofaurum.com) (PC and phones, nothing to install)

Heading to bed now. Ask me anything: the workflow, how the agents were set up, the multiplayer, what Opus is great at and where it still trips. I'll answer them all tomorrow. :)

comments.author: ErickWickings
comments.body:
Where did you post it / advertise it / show it to get 1'000 players on day one?  
Honnestly, for me trying to trust my vision and my own sense that something is or isn't fun is the hardest part... SOme days I love my game... Others I just think it's pure.... "slop" lol
